# Boomi fixtures captured from a live account

Every file under this directory was captured from a disposable Boomi demo account
(AtomSphere accounts used only for development and testing) by running the MCP tools or the Boomi
Platform API against it. They are FROZEN inputs: the tests compare the implementation
against them, so they are never regenerated by the code under test.

| Directory | Read by | Captured for |
|---|---|---|
| `connector_replay/` | `tests/test_connector_replay_*.py`, `tests/test_issue_155_*.py`, `scripts/ingest_connector_replay_evidence.py`, `scripts/connector_replay_digest_parity.py` | issue #155 (connector replay registry) |
| `process_ir/issue184/` | `tests/test_issue_184_*.py` | issue #184 (child entries, document emission) |
| `process_ir/issue156/` | `tests/test_process_ir_notify_recovery.py`, `tests/_process_ir_capability_witnesses.py` | issue #156 (notify and recovery) |
| `process_ir/issue175/` | `tests/test_wrapper_subprocess_builder.py` | issue #175 (terminal Process Call) |
| `listeners/issue158/` | `tests/test_issue_158_*.py` | issue #158 (WSS listener) |

Rules:

- Bytes are a contract. `connector_replay/SHA256SUMS` and `process_ir/issue184/SHA256SUMS`
  list every file by path relative to their directory; the replay ingester refuses a
  capture whose bytes, file set or names differ (`boomi_mcp.connector_replay.ingest`).
  `.gitattributes` disables line-ending conversion for this tree.
- `process_ir/issue184/document_emission/CAPTURE_INDEX.json` is generated by the
  `build_capture_index.py` beside it; a test rebuilds it and compares byte for byte.
- A capture directory may not gain any file (not even a README): the capture identity
  hashes every file name and byte inside it.
